packageRules.description: Reviewers for backend dependency MRs. The OpenAPI bot (.gitlab/ci/scripts/update-openapi-spec.mjs) also takes its reviewers from this rule. Everything else about backend dependencies is in the renovate-config preset.

customManagers.description: Track Docker image versions declared as Testcontainers Java constants. Lines annotated with '// renovate: datasource=docker' immediately above a 'public static final String NAME = "image:tag"' constant are matched. The existing pinDigests rule additionally appends @sha256: digests for full reproducibility.
